summary.verdict: The motor conforms to its documented contract: it detects source, schema, availability, access, fingerprint, freshness and advisory priority signals from motor_008, motor_004 and motor_002 evidence without downloading data, mutating upstream records or making executable recapture decisions.

findings: Implementation accepts the documented upstream inputs source_registry, ingestion_records and version_history and emits only change_detection_event, refresh_priority, staleness_signal and structured errors.

ChangeEvent, RefreshPriority and StalenessRecord fields match the technical schema, including stable ids, version_hash, source_ref, produced_by_motor, produced_at, parent_id, evidence_refs and lineage-preserving fields.

Priority output remains advisory: the implementation does not download data, authenticate to sources, enqueue recapture jobs, rewrite source registry entries, rewrite ingestion records or rewrite version history.
Validation paths cover INVALID_SOURCE_REFERENCE, MISSING_COMPARISON_EVIDENCE, INVALID_TEMPORAL_ORDER and UNTRACEABLE_CHANGE_EVENT without emitting partial outputs for rejected source batches.
All persisted output models include version_id, created_at, updated_at, version_hash, source_ref, produced_by_motor and produced_at.
Identifiers and hashes are derived from canonical content and evidence references rather than random values or input list order.
Lineage references are preserved from version_history when present and fall back to reconstructible source or ingestion references when version lineage is unavailable.
Upstream inputs are deep-copied before processing, preserving motor_008, motor_004 and motor_002 records as read-only evidence.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Targeted in-process smoke execution covered the documented happy path and one mandatory malformed-input rejection. The check confirmed one schema ChangeEvent, one watch StalenessRecord, one high RefreshPriority, no happy-path errors and INVALID_SOURCE_REFERENCE rejection.
test_results.notes: No standalone pytest suite is present in this artifact scope; conformance was assessed by reviewing the closed documentation, schema, test specification, failure modes and executable implementation, then running the documented engine behavior through .venv/bin/python with bytecode writes disabled.
